full_text_zh:
[P1] 传统童谣
连环画出版社
不倒翁

[P2] 不倒翁
金波／编选
胡永凯／图
连环画出版社

[P3] 板凳板凳歪歪
板凳板凳歪歪，
里面坐个乖乖，
乖乖出来买菜；
里面坐个奶奶，
奶奶出来烧汤；
里面坐个姑娘，
姑娘出来梳头；
里面坐个小猴，
小猴出来作揖；
里面坐个公鸡，
公鸡出来打鸣；
里面坐个豆虫，
豆虫出来咕咕茸，咕咕茸。

[P4] 不倒翁
说你呆，你真呆，
胡子一大把，
模样像小孩儿。
说你呆，你不呆，
把你推一推，
你就歪一歪，
要你睡下去，
你又站起来。

[P5] 小孩你别哭
小孩小孩你别哭，
过了腊八就杀猪；
小孩小孩你别馋，
过了腊八就是年。

[P6] 屋里点个灯
屋里点个灯，
灯底下是个坑，
坑边上长棵葱，
葱头上钉个钉，
钉上挂只鹰，
鹰脖里挂张弓。
忽然刮了一阵风，
刮灭了灯，
刮平了坑，
刮倒了葱，
刮掉了钉，
刮飞了鹰，
带走了弓。

[P7] 荆条棍儿
荆条棍儿用处多，
编了柳斗编笸箩；
笸箩倒比柳斗大，
管着柳斗叫“哥哥”。

[P8] 小巴狗，挂铃铛，
小巴狗，挂铃铛
叮当叮当到集上。
爱吃桃，桃有毛，
爱吃杏，杏又酸，
爱吃李子面丹丹，
爱吃小枣咯嘣甜。

[P9] 姥姥家唱大戏
拉大锯，扯大锯，
姥姥家，唱大戏。
接姑娘，请女婿，
小外孙女你也去。

[P10] 一个毽儿
一个毽儿，
踢两半儿，
打花鼓儿，
绕花线儿，
里踢外拐，
八仙过海，
九十九个一百。

[P11] 奶奶夸我孝顺小儿
小板凳，三条腿，
我给奶奶磕瓜子儿。
奶奶嫌我磕得脏，
我给奶奶煮面汤。
奶奶嫌我煮得硬，
我给奶奶剥花生。
奶奶嫌我剥得慢，
我给奶奶蒸米饭。
大米饭，蒸得好，
奶奶夸我孝顺小儿。

[P12] 狼外婆
咕嘟咕嘟颠颠，
颠到外婆门前，
外婆出来赶狗，
骑着花马就走。
“外婆”问我：
“咋个不下马？”，
我说：
“这里不是外婆家。”
“外婆”问我：
“说的什么话？”，
我说：
“你的屁股后面有条狼尾巴。”

[P13] 高高山上一条藤
高高山上一条藤，
藤条头上挂铜铃。
风吹藤动铜铃动，
风定藤停铜铃停。

[P14] 什么有腿不会走
什么有腿不会走？
什么没腿游遍九州？
什么有嘴不说话？
什么没嘴吱吱扭扭？
板凳有腿不会走，
大船没腿游遍九州，
茶壶有嘴不会说话，
小车子没嘴吱吱扭扭。

[P15] 张打铁
张打铁，
李打铁，
打把剪刀送姐姐。
姐姐留我歇，
我不歇，
我要回家学打铁。

[P16] 月亮走
月亮走，
我也走，
我给月亮提竹篓。
竹篓里面两个蛋，
拿给娃娃下稀饭。

[P17] 瞌睡来
月亮光光照窗台，
打个呵欠瞌睡来。
踏板叫我脱花鞋，
枕头叫我倒下来，
席子叫我伸长腿，
被子叫我不要蒙着嘴。
full_text_en:
[P1] Traditional Children's Rhymes
Lianhuanhua Publishing House
The Tumbler

[P2] Cockroach
Jin Bo / Compiler and Selector
Hu Yongkai / Illustrations
Lianhuanhua Publishing House

[P3] Board bench, board bench, crooked crooked
Board bench, board bench, crooked crooked,
Inside sits a little child,
The little child comes out to buy vegetables;
Inside sits a grandma,
The grandma comes out to cook soup;
Inside sits a girl,
The girl comes out to comb her hair;
Inside sits a little monkey,
The little monkey comes out to bow;
Inside sits a rooster,
The rooster comes out to crow;
Inside sits a bean bug,
The bean bug comes out to gobble, gobble.

[P4] Wobbly Man
Say you're silly, you really are,
With a big beard,
Looking like a child.
Say you're silly, you're not silly,
Push you a bit,
You wobble a bit,
Make you lie down,
You stand up again.

[P5] Don't cry, child
Child, child, don't cry,
After Laba, we'll slaughter the pig;
Child, child, don't be greedy,
After Laba, it's the New Year.

[P6] Light a Lamp in the House
Light a lamp in the house,
Under the lamp is a pit,
By the pit grows a green onion,
On the onion's head, a nail is driven,
On the nail hangs an eagle,
In the eagle's neck, a bow is hung.
Suddenly, a gust of wind blows,
It blows out the lamp,
Flattens the pit,
Knocks over the onion,
Removes the nail,
Flies away the eagle,
And takes the bow.

[P7] Willow Branches
Willow branches have many uses,
Weaving baskets and weaving baskets;
The basket is bigger than the basket,
Calling the basket "brother".

[P8] Little short-tailed dog, with a bell around its neck,
Little short-tailed dog, with a bell around its neck,
Ting-tang, ting-tang, to the market it goes.
Loves peaches, peaches have fuzz,
Loves apricots, apricots are sour,
Loves plums, plums are smooth and red,
Loves little dates, sweet and crisp.

[P9] Grandma's house is putting on a big show
Pull the big saw, pull the big saw,
At Grandma's house, a big show is on.
Bring the daughter-in-law, invite the son-in-law,
Little granddaughter, you go too.

[P10] A shuttlecock
A shuttlecock,
Kick it in half,
Hit the flower drum,
Wrap it with flower thread,
Kick inside, turn outside,
The Eight Immortals cross the sea,
Ninety-nine, then one hundred.

[P11] Grandma praises me for being a filial child
Little stool, three legs,
I crack melon seeds for Grandma.
Grandma says I make a mess,
I cook noodle soup for Grandma.
Grandma says I cook it too hard,
I peel peanuts for Grandma.
Grandma says I peel too slowly,
I steam rice for Grandma.
Steamed rice, cooked well,
Grandma praises me for being a filial child.

[P12] Wolf Grandma
Gudu gudu, shaking and shaking,
Shaking to Grandma's door,
Grandma comes out to chase the dog,
Rides the flower horse and leaves.
"Grandma" asks me:
"Why don't you get off the horse?",
I say:
"This is not Grandma's house."
"Grandma" asks me:
"What are you talking about?",
I say:
"There's a wolf's tail behind your butt."

[P13] High on the mountain, a vine
High on the mountain, a vine,
At the tip of the vine hangs a bronze bell.
The wind blows, the vine moves, the bronze bell rings,
The wind stops, the vine stops, the bronze bell stops.

[P14] What has legs but cannot walk?
What has legs but cannot walk?
What has no legs but travels across the nine provinces?
What has a mouth but doesn't speak?
What has no mouth but makes a creaking sound?
A stool has legs but cannot walk,
A big boat has no legs but travels across the nine provinces,
A teapot has a mouth but doesn't speak,
A little cart has no mouth but creaks.

[P15] Zhang the Blacksmith
Zhang the blacksmith,
Li the blacksmith,
Hammering a pair of scissors to give to my sister.
Sister invites me to rest,
I won't rest,
I want to go home and learn blacksmithing.

[P16] Moon walks
Moon walks,
I walk too,
I carry a bamboo basket for the moon.
Inside the basket are two eggs,
To cook porridge for the baby.

[P17] Sleepy Time
Moonlight shines on the windowsill,
Yawn, and sleepy time comes.
The step tells me to take off my flower shoes,
The pillow tells me to lie down,
The mat tells me to stretch my legs,
The blanket tells me not to cover my mouth.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，左侧竖排绿色大字为“传统童谣”，右侧为色彩鲜艳的剪纸风格插画，包含多个猫脸和花卉图案，底部横排白色大字为“不倒翁”，右下角有“连环画出版社”字样。
[P2] 本页为绘本的扉页，显示书名《不倒翁》，编选者为金波，插图作者为胡永凯，出版社为连环画出版社，左下角有一幅彩色的鱼形剪纸图案。
[P3] 本页展示了一首名为《板凳板凳歪歪》的传统童谣，配图描绘了多个角色（包括孩子、奶奶、姑娘、小猴、公鸡和豆虫）从一个类似板凳的结构中依次出现的场景，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P4] 本页展示了一首名为《不倒翁》的传统童谣，配图描绘了两个具有典型特征的不倒翁形象，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P5] 本页展示了一首名为《小孩你别哭》的传统童谣，配图描绘了一个哭泣的小孩被一位女性安慰，背景中有两人抬着一头猪，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P6] 本页展示了一首名为《屋里点个灯》的传统童谣，配图描绘了灯、坑、葱、钉、鹰和弓等元素，画面风格为剪纸艺术，表现了风刮过后这些物品被破坏或带走的场景。
[P7] 本页展示了一首名为《荆条棍儿》的传统童谣，配图描绘了一位女性正在用荆条编织篮子的场景，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P8] 本页展示了一首名为《小巴狗，挂铃铛》的传统童谣，配图描绘了一只戴着铃铛、身上有花纹的黑色小狗，周围环绕着桃子、杏子、李子和小枣等水果，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P9] 本页展示了一首名为《姥姥家唱大戏》的传统童谣，配图描绘了人们聚集在戏台前观看戏曲表演的热闹场景，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P10] 本页展示了一首名为《一个毽儿》的传统童谣，配图描绘了两个孩子正在踢毽子，旁边有一只黑猫在观看，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P11] 本页展示了一首名为《奶奶夸我孝顺小儿》的传统童谣，描绘了孩子为奶奶做各种家务，尽管奶奶嫌做得不够好，但最终因米饭蒸得好而受到夸奖，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P12] 本页展示了一首名为《狼外婆》的传统童谣，配图描绘了一个小女孩骑着花马来到外婆家门前，发现门口站着一个披着人皮的狼外婆，小女孩机智地指出其身后有狼尾巴，揭穿了伪装。画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P13] 本页展示了一首名为《高高山上一条藤》的传统童谣，配图描绘了一个孩子站在山间，双手各持一捆柴火，抬头仰望缠绕在山石上的藤蔓，藤蔓顶端挂着一个铜铃，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P14] 本页展示了一首名为《什么有腿不会走》的传统童谣，通过问答形式引出答案，并配以板凳、大船、茶壶和小车的剪纸风格插图，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P15] 本页展示了一首名为《张打铁》的传统童谣，配图描绘了两位铁匠在炉火旁打铁，一位姐姐手持剪刀，一个孩子欢快地跑向她，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P16] 本页展示了一首名为《月亮走》的传统童谣，配图描绘了一个小女孩在月夜下提着装有鸡蛋的竹篮行走，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
[P17] 本页展示了一首名为《瞌睡来》的传统童谣，配图描绘了一个孩子在月光下躺在床上准备入睡，周围有枕头、席子、被子等物品，画面风格为剪纸艺术。
